metadata.methodology: 38 evaluation metrics normalized [0,1] and transformed via zero-leakage strictly monotone piecewise-linear curves g_b, bounded learned weights w_b, and Pseudo-Huber IRLS robust aggregation (src/mapping.py) → composite ability, then re-normalized linearly so best model = 1 and worst = 0 (raw equal-weight mean preserved as composite_ability_raw_uncalibrated); Pareto = non-dominated by per-request cost (cost 0/free models participate); chart Y-axis (V17): y = 0 at the FIRST (lowest) level of the overall Pareto frontier — models below it are excluded from the chart but kept in the table; chart_y = (ability-y0)/(1-y0); X-axis (V17): exact empirical-quantile (rank) mapping over the chart-visible models — piecewise-linear in log10(c), equal-cost ties averaged, endpoints pinned at (0,0) and (1,1), uniform density (x linear in rank: any equal-width segment holds the same number of models); 10^x magnitude indicators sit at x(10^x), so same-multiplier decade widths are proportional to the model count inside that decade; 14 brands get their own thin Pareto lines (brand theme colors, drawn above the solid gray overall Pareto line; vertices ordered by (axis_x, ability) so equal-cost points connect bottom-up); dark brand elements carry a narrow white outline on the black canvas; labels ride ON the Pareto lines when the adjacent segment allows (parallel to the line, mid-axis coincident, line gapped under the text, bare brand-colored text), else take the nearest free spot; every label = model family (brand-shared leading block stripped at the longest valid cut: ending at a separator, or at a letter followed by a digit in every name) plus thinking level, '(non-reasoning)' shortened to '(non)'; 2+ consecutive same-family vertices shorten to level-only labels after the run head (runs recomputed per brand; non-adjacent occurrences keep full labels)

cost_formula.expression: (CacheHitRate * CacheHitPrice * InputTokens) + ((1 - CacheHitRate) * CacheWritePrice * InputTokens) + (Speed * RealTime * OutputPrice)
cost_formula.cache_write_price_fallback: If cacheWritePrice is missing, falls back to price1mInputTokens (regular input price)

real_time_logic.non_reasoning_model: EndToEndResponseTimeTotal (= medianEndToEndResponseTimeSeconds, when medianReasoningTimeSeconds is null/'--')

cost_formula.units_note: AA prices are USD per 1M tokens, InputTokens is a raw count (10000), Speed is tokens/sec, RealTime is seconds. The formula is applied as-is with no unit conversion — the resulting cost is a relative score used only for Pareto comparison and axis mapping.

x_axis_mapping.mapping: EXPERIMENTAL log mapping Y=A*ln(B*c+C)+D fitted on the 11 brand-frontier models, pins RAW (0,0)/(cmax,1), B=1, C=1/r
x_axis_mapping.function: x = A*ln(c+C)+D with C=344.5259 (A=0.125009 B=1 D=-0.730321, ln); f(0)=0, f(cmax)=1 exactly; cost>cmax chart-excluded (table x=1.0)

fit.method: least-squares fit of r=B/C over log grid (pins solve A,D)

y_axis.note: chart y = (ability - baseline)/(1 - baseline); models below the first overall-Pareto level are excluded from the chart but kept in the README table
chart y = (ability - baseline)/(1 - baseline); models below the first overall-Pareto level are excluded from the chart but kept in the README table

x_axis_distribution.note: log mapping (V21): x = A*ln(B*c+C)+D fitted on brand-frontier models; endpoints pinned raw (0,0)/(1,1); left edge c = 0; 10^x indicators sit at x(10^x)
